profile.summary: Software Engineer with Bluetooth and Bluetooth Low Energy expertise.

positions.title: Staff Bluetooth Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working on the next generation infotainment system and technologies.

Designing with wireless coexistence in mind.

Focused on Bluetooth and Bluetooth LE.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented the HCI layer of LE Audio Broadcast enabling the streaming of audio to multiple devices.

Implemented the HCI layer of LE Audio Unicast allowing testing and development of the end-to-end experience including controller partners.

Designed, implemented, and patented a mechanism called Seamless Pairing released on Windows 11 and shipped for the Surface Pro 8, Surface Laptop Studio, and the Surface Slim Pen 2. 

Created dialogs and scripts to fix users’ Bluetooth issues. Integrated this with Windows Get Help tool. Saving Microsoft hundreds of thousands of dollars in IT services.
positions.insights: Bluetooth Low Energy, LE Audio and +3 skills

company.name: The University of Texas at El Paso

positions.title: Webmaster
positions.description:
Designed and implemented the center’s new website.
Managed our web server running Windows Server 2012, which included mitigating vulnerabilities and managing a SQL server.

Developed a variety of web applications to avoid manually performing repetitive tasks and managing data collected by the Center. This was mostly done using PHP and MySQL.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Researched game theory topics and gained a foundational understanding through reading and discussing research papers with group members.

Collaborated on the development of a testbed for experimenting with game-playing agents to enhance strategic analysis methods.

Conducted research on the application of game theory to network security, focusing on optimal honeypot allocation strategies to deceive attackers and enhance network security.

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description:
Member of a multidisciplinary team that developed a predictive algorithm to reduce employee turnover at Bosch’s manufacturing plant in Juárez, Mexico.

Analyzed company data to identify key drivers of attrition using text analysis of exit surveys, API-based tools, and techniques for processing unstructured data.

Conducted data analysis and visualization to uncover trends and potential solutions.

Built an artificial neural network to rank the most influential factors and developed a predictive model that assigns attrition risk scores to employees and prospective hires.

The algorithm contributed to a reduction in Bosch’s annual turnover rate (exact figures undisclosed).

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at El Paso

projects.title: Hackathon First Place Winner
projects.description:
Participated in the XBuild 2018 hackathon, winning the Trimble challenge: designing a solution for obstacle navigation in GPS-challenged environments using stereo camera data.
After working with the provided dataset, I delved into computer vision with OpenCV to detect features in images captured by two aligned cameras. Successfully calculating the relative object-camera distance, we secured first place in the Trimble challenge, addressing the issue of GPS reliability in specific environments.

projects.title: Hackathon First Place Winner
projects.description: Won first place in a hackathon sponsored by Microsoft. My role centered around integrating an Azure database server into a mobile application aimed at enhancing sleep quality. This application enabled real-time data storage and retrieval, including information from a brainwave sensor connected to a Raspberry Pi. The sensor allowed us to determine the user's current sleep phase. With this data, we could assess whether the user woke up during a restorative sleep phase or not. Leveraging this information, our mobile application generated notifications offering recommendations for sleep improvement.

patents.title: Establishing wireless pairing via electrostatic interface using temporary key
patents.description: Designed and implemented a mechanism to establish a Bluetooth pairing by sharing the OOB information through an electrostatic interface. This mechanism is currently used in the Surface Pro 8, Surface Pro 9, Surface Laptop Studio, and the Surface Slim Pen 2.
